_readme: One entry per track. Put the audio file in assets/music/ and set 'file'. Entries whose file is missing are skipped. Only instrumental tracks without a strong lead melody (the narration sits on top). 'attribution' is added to the video description automatically when not empty. 'start_offset_s' skips a slow intro; 'gain_db' fine-tunes loudness after normalisation.
